current) Election Night Results November 3, 2026 - General Election Stay Tuned View Unofficial Results Monroe County Supervisor of Elections Current Election Results and Information 2026 Primary Election Vote-by-Mail Count Reporting Per FS §102.072 : Total Vote-by-Mail Ballots Sent to Voters: 11,802 Total Vote-by-Mail Ballots Returned by Voters: 7320 Total Vote-by-Mail Ballots Unreturned by Voters: 4482 2026 Primary Election Day Precinct Results Will Be Reported Later Than Usual Monroe County voters should expect Election Day precinct results to be released later than in recent elections, Supervisor of Elections Sherri Hodies announced Friday. The delay applies only to ballots cast at precincts on Election Day. Early Voting and Vote-by-Mail results will be available by 7:30 p.m. on election night.
